message: kukulu_plan_commit checks the plan's structure but runs neither the constraints' fixture self-test and scan nor the project's lint over the new files, so to know the first kukulu_verify would not start red the planner had to hand-write a constraint self-test and scan script and run lint, pre-commit and the plugin suite with the untracked plan files staged through git add -N. A dry-run mode (or a constraints-only check in kukulu_plan_commit) would remove that.
